issues.reason: An explicit "no" is exactly what Negation (copular) says sets strength 0.0, and a negated multi-atom predicate nominal is required to go into one strength-0 (And …) bundle — so the parse applies the stated rule to the sentence's own surface claim; the evaluative "not a PROPER way" force has no licensed carrier at all (the reviewer files it as a gap), and objecting to a rule-conforming rendering in gap territory is what the calibration line bars.

gaps_confirmed: evaluative / normative predicate nominal "is no way to V": the negation targets propriety rather than category membership, and no construct records that force
to-infinitive complement of a noun ("a way TO treat a lady"): Complements of nouns and adjectives covers PP arguments, not infinitival complements
new_gaps: existential import of an indefinite inside a noun's unasserted infinitival complement: the complement eventuality is reified top-level with no status (so it asserts no occurrence), but nothing states whether the indefinite participant's typing atom — (Member sk_lady_1 lady) at strength 1.0 — projects to top level or stays unasserted with it
notes: The bundle denial, the antecedent-less "this" typed thing (it cannot be typed way, which the sentence denies), Theme for treat, and the status-free treat event all follow the instruction set; head To on an entity is a coherent extension of the noun-complement oblique and asserts nothing false.
